# Stage 7: time and energy of one forward pass (HCR layer vs MLP and KAN)

*Generated by `python -m gpu.energy --summarise` from 6 runs (3495720, 3495818, 3495886, 3495994, 3496180, 3496276); separate from the statistical study.*

GPU NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, driver 595.91.07, power limit 400 W, max SM clock 1410 MHz (clocks not locked; median SM clock per row below). Idle power 58 W, 59 W, 59 W, 62 W, 57 W, 61 W. W = 64 units, HCR pair basis m = 4, EXACT_CAL with S = 64 samples per belief and 192 x-nodes; MLP and KAN are k -> H -> W with H chosen to match the HCR parameter count. Medians over 30 repeats x runs; range = min-max of the run medians. Energy = NVML power sampled every 10 ms and integrated; `counter` = device energy counter / sampled energy. TF32 off.
